description.describe_ch: 學生通過本課程的學習，可獲得電子元件和電聲領域電子電路的基本知識與分析技術，掌握並進一步地探討音頻信號實用的加工處理技術。由本課程中培養學生針對電聲學電子領域中分析問題和解決問題以及使用SPICE電子電路模擬軟體的能力，為往後其他進階學習的電聲課程打下實用的電子基礎。
description.describe_eh: After this course, students can be familiar with the basic electronic devices and the primary techniques for the analysis of the electronic circuits. In additions, they can deal with the problems and make some solutions using the circuit simulation software such as SPICE. With this ability, they can do more advanced studies on the electro-acoustic field.

targets.describe_ch: 具有電子元件特性與應用方式的基礎知識。
targets.describe_en: Knowledge for the electronic elements about characteristics and applications.

targets.describe_ch: 理解電子電路之結構與分析所用之方法。
targets.describe_en: Comprehension for the electronic circuits about their structure and analysis method.

targets.describe_ch: 有能力使用電子電路專業軟體驗證電子電路分析之結果。
targets.describe_en: Application of circuit-simulator for the  verification of the results of the electronic circuits.
